name: Hybrid CPU-GPU FVR Pipeline
definition: A pipeline implementation strategy where the computational context (FFT, resampling) runs on the CPU, and the rendering context (slice extraction, display) runs on the GPU via OpenGL.
summary: The Hybrid CPU-GPU FVR Pipeline partitions Fourier Volume Rendering by using the CPU for heavy numerical computations and the GPU for rendering, leveraging OpenGL texture handling to simplify 3D spectral volume representation.
